rows.grounds: metaphorical designation of the body interior

items.question: Why is the interior of the body designated as a cremation ground?
premises: Time is devoured within the body.
A cremation ground is a place of dissolution.
That inner locus is traditionally remembered as such.
items.inference: Because it devours time, the body's interior is identified as a cremation ground.
items.plain_english: Within the body it devours time; therefore that is remembered as the cremation ground.

rows.grounds: reason for the designation of skin
outer bodily layer identified as cremation ground

items.question: On what basis is the skin identified as the outer cremation ground?
premises: The skin has the nature of devouring time.
The cremation ground designation applies outwardly.
An outer locus is distinguished from the inner one.
items.inference: Because of its time-devouring nature, the skin is the cremation ground outside.
items.plain_english: Because of its nature of devouring time, the skin is indeed the cremation ground on the outside.

rows.grounds: fragmentary ending indicating two agents or means
compound naming the guardian of the field

items.question: How does protection upon the earth lead to the designation of the field guardian?
premises: An act of protection is asserted despite textual gaps.
The locus of protection is upon the earth.
The field guardian is named thereafter.
items.inference: Protection in the earthly field establishes the role of the field guardian.
uncertainties: Four tokens are unreadable lacunae marked by asterisks.
The full grammatical relation of bhyāṃ is unclear due to missing context.
items.plain_english: I protect... by the two; upon the earth, thereafter, is the guardian of the field.

rows.grounds: title derived from protecting the field
fragmentary form indicating relation to a corpse

items.question: What justifies calling the protector the field lord identified with the corpse?
premises: The field is protected.
Protection yields the title field lord.
The lord is described as consisting of that.
items.inference: By protecting the field, the guardian is the field lord and is identified with that corpse-nature.
uncertainties: The token -śavasyai is fragmentary and its exact syntactic role is unclear.
items.plain_english: Because he protects the field, he is indeed the lord of the field, consisting of that, for the corpse.

rows.grounds: emphatic identification of the feminine principle
refers to the protected field or its essence

items.question: How does protecting the field establish her identity with that very nature?
premises: The field is protected.
Identity is expressed through that nature.
She alone is identified as that.
items.inference: Through the act of protection and shared nature, she alone is that.
items.plain_english: Because she protects the field, by that very nature she alone is that.

rows.grounds: melāpa, the yoginī assembly or fusion

items.question: In what way is the union identified as the devourer of dissolution through perfect fusion?
premises: Perfect fusion constitutes her nature.
This she is the union.
The union devours dissolution.
items.inference: By the nature of perfect fusion, this union is the devourer of dissolution.
items.plain_english: By the nature of perfect fusion, she, this union, is the devourer of dissolution.

items.question: How does perfect fusion operate through turning back on all sides?
premises: Perfect fusion constitutes her nature.
A turning back occurs.
This turning back pervades on all sides.
items.inference: By the nature of perfect fusion, she operates through a turning back on all sides.
items.plain_english: By the nature of perfect fusion, she, this one, acts by turning back on all sides.

rows.grounds: origin in the experience of sense objects

items.question: What nourishes the wonder that arises from the enjoyment of sense objects?
premises: Experience arises from the enjoyment of sense objects.
Wonder is present in that experience.
This wonder is nourished and intensified.
items.inference: The wonder arising from sense enjoyment is nourished and expanded.
uncertainties: The syntactic subject of this verse is carried over from the preceding context.
items.plain_english: Arisen from the enjoyment of sense objects, it is nourished by wonder.

rows.grounds: mode of being as a seed

items.question: How is the tender union characterized in its seed state and inward selfhood?
premises: The union exists in the nature of a seed state.
The union is tender.
The union is present by the inward self.
items.inference: The tender union is characterized as a seed state realized through the inward self.
items.plain_english: The union which, by the nature of the seed state and by the inward self, is tender.

fragmentary or sandhi-affected form related to union

items.question: How is the tasting of the inner essence of sameness experienced through union?

items.plain_english: Through union, the tasting of the inner essence of sameness is experienced by the self.

items.question: Why does impetuous striking become the cause of supreme satisfaction?
premises: A striking occurs impetuously.
This striking is ongoing.
It functions as a cause of supreme satisfaction.
items.inference: When struck impetuously, that event becomes the cause of supreme satisfaction.
uncertainties: The subject undergoing striking is implied from preceding verses.
items.plain_english: When being struck impetuously, it becomes the cause of supreme satisfaction.
